subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should this PR wait for real embedded-agent proof of the internal-handoff drop and `sessions_send` preservation paths before merge, or should maintainers accept equivalent private proof and the six-source predicate scope?
rationale: The repository policy makes real behavior proof a merge gate for external PRs, and the diff changes session-state prompt semantics that tests alone do not settle.

options.title: Require real embedded-runner proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, runtime logs, or a recording from an embedded-agent run that shows stale internal handoff text is dropped while `sessions_send` content is preserved.

options.title: Accept maintainer-held proof
options.body: Proceed only if maintainers already have equivalent private runtime evidence and explicitly own the session-state predicate scope.

options.title: Narrow before proof
options.body: Pause the PR and narrow the source-tool predicate if not all six internal handoff tools should be dropped from orphan repair.

recommendation.title: Require real embedded-runner proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, runtime logs, or a recording from an embedded-agent run that shows stale internal handoff text is dropped while `sessions_send` content is preserved.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the queued-user prompt preservation invariant introduced in fcae3bf9433b and the embedded-runner prompt repair boundary.
